# ADR NNNN: Title

- **Status**: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded by ADR-XXXX | Deprecated
- **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Deciders**: (names)

## Context

What is the issue or decision we're facing? What forces are at play (technical,
political, social, project)? Keep it short — link out to longer discussions.

## Decision

What did we decide? Use the active voice: "We will…".

## Consequences

What becomes easier? What becomes harder? What follow-up work falls out of
this decision?

## Alternatives considered

What other options were on the table and why were they rejected?
